FAMILY FARES. One child under two years old not
occupying a seat may fly free when accompanied by a
passenger twelve years old
over. All children under
twelve may fly for one-half fare.
MILITARY FARES. Military personnel on leave may travel
for one-half fare on a space available basis. Consult your
Air California agent for details.
